sources.entry: Galette - Membership management web application aimed towards non profit organizations. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Galette is a web-based membership management application for non-profit organizations, released under GPLv3.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Galette as a membership management web application aimed at non-profit organizations (French: a tool for managing members and membership dues online). It is released under GPLv3. The README links to an external website for detailed feature descriptions, documentation, bug tracking, mailing lists and translations, but does not list specific features itself. Installation options given are downloading the latest stable release from the Galette website, using a nightly build to test new features, or cloning the source repository and installing third-party dependencies. The README states the project is tested with BrowserStack.
how_to_run: Download the latest stable version from the Galette website
Or use the nightly build from the Galette website
Or clone the source repository and install third-party dependencies
After checkout, run bin/serve to bring up a ready-to-test instance with database included
notable: bin/serve starts a ready-to-test instance with database included
caveats: Source-based setup requires technical skills and third-party dependencies
Detailed documentation and feature list are on an external website, not in the README
